name: ios-simulator-bridge
description: Drive a Mac-hosted iOS Simulator from a remote Codex host through SSH and project-owned adapters.

interface.longDescription: Provides generic SSH, simctl, WebKit inspection, screenshot, appearance, and diagnostic workflows while projects retain their builds and acceptance contracts.
